h1: The 8 Best Narrow Nightstands of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 narrow nightstands compared on width, charging, storage and capacity, from 7-inch shelves to a farmhouse drawer table.
summary: The LOAKEKEL Narrow Nightstand with USB-C is the best slim table with power: 7.87 inches wide, two fabric drawers, two AC outlets and USB-A plus USB-C. For the narrowest and cheapest, the Vantimo is only 7.08 inches wide. For real storage, the Giantex farmhouse table is rated to 210 lb. And for a pair of matching tables, the LOAKEKEL set of two includes a lifetime warranty.
intro: Narrow nightstands exist to fit gaps: between a bed and a wall, beside a door, or in a studio where every inch counts. The trade is simple. The slimmer the table, the less it holds, and the first question is how much width you can truly spare.

We reviewed eight narrow models on paper, spanning open shelves, drawers and charging tables. Where a source listed width and depth in a confusing order, we used the smallest dimension as the narrow side. Ranking starts with how much storage and power each gets out of its footprint.

products.name: LOAKEKEL Narrow Nightstand with USB-C
products.verdict: 7.87 inches wide with a full charging station and two closed fabric drawers.
products.description:
LOAKEKEL measures 15.75 x 7.87 x 23.22 inches in engineered wood and metal. It has two AC outlets, a USB-A port, a USB-C port, an LED light and two fabric drawers with a 44 lb capacity.

It wins because it is the narrowest table with charging and still gives closed drawers. The open-shelf models are slimmer but give you neither power nor hidden storage.

Buy it for a tight bedroom that needs power at hand. The caveat is the fabric drawers, which suit light items.
products.skipIf: You want a plain open shelf.

products.name: LOAKEKEL Narrow Nightstand Set of 2
products.verdict: Two matching charging nightstands with a lifetime warranty.
products.description:
This set includes two 15.74 x 7.87 x 23.22 inch tables, each with two AC outlets, a USB-A port, a USB-C port and two fabric drawers. The listing includes a lifetime warranty.

It ranks second because a pair suits couples, and matching hardware saves hunting for two compatible tables. It is the single-table LOAKEKEL times two.

Best for a shared bedroom. The caveat is that you only need it if you want two.

products.name: Giantex Farmhouse Narrow Nightstand
products.verdict: A 210 lb capacity with a pull-out drawer, two shelves and rubberwood legs.
products.description:
Giantex measures 23.5 x 12 x 24.5 inches in engineered wood and MDF with rubberwood legs, one pull-out drawer, two shelves and non-slip pads. It has the highest stated capacity here at 210 lb.

It ranks third because it is the sturdiest, but it is not very narrow at 12 inches. It beats the shelf models for storage.

Best for a bedside that carries books and a lamp. The caveat is the larger footprint.

products.name: Vantimo 3-Tier Narrow Nightstand
products.verdict: Only 7.08 inches wide, with three open tiers and adjustable footpads.
products.description:
Vantimo measures 7.08 x 16.92 x 22.24 inches in particleboard with a black metal frame. It has three open tiers and a 40 lb capacity, with adjustable footpads and a stain-resistant lacquered finish.

It ranks fourth because it is the narrowest and the cheapest, but it has no drawers or power. It suits the tightest gaps better than anything else here.

Best for a very tight spot. The caveat is exposed storage.

products.name: HOOBRO Industrial Narrow Nightstand
products.verdict: Five-minute tool-free assembly and a 50 lb capacity.
products.description:
HOOBRO measures 15 x 11 x 19.7 inches in engineered wood with a metal frame and two open shelves. It has a 50 lb capacity and the listing states tool-free assembly in five minutes.

It ranks fifth because it is the quickest to build and strong for its price, but it is the shortest at 19.7 inches, which suits a low bed only.

Best for renters who want fast setup. The caveat is low height.
products.idealFor: Renters who want a quick build.

products.name: Furinno JUST 3-Tier Nightstand
products.verdict: FSC-certified and CARB-compliant with rounded corners.
products.description:
Furinno measures 13.4 x 11.5 x 22.8 inches in CARB-compliant composite wood with PVC tubes, with three open tiers and a 30 lb capacity. It is FSC certified and has rounded corners.

It ranks sixth because the material credentials are good but 30 lb is the lowest capacity here. The rounded corners help in a tight space.

Best for a safety-minded buyer. The caveat is the low capacity.
products.skipIf: You need to hold heavier items.

products.name: Yoobure Narrow 3-Tier Nightstand with Basket
products.verdict: A narrow three-tier with a fitted storage basket.
products.description:
Yoobure measures 7.9 x 16.5 x 24.5 inches in engineered wood and metal with three tiers, one storage basket and adjustable footpads.

It ranks seventh because it matches the LOAKEKEL's width without the power, and the basket hides small items. It is the tallest of the no-charging narrow tables here.

Best for hiding small items on a narrow table. The caveat is no charging.
pros: Tallest of the no-charging narrow picks
cons: Basket is the only closed storage
products.idealFor: Narrow spaces that need some hidden storage.

products.name: Homleke Skinny Narrow Nightstand
products.verdict: A 7.1 inch deep shelf table with a removable mesh magazine basket.
products.description:
Homleke measures 7.1 x 16.9 x 23.6 inches in engineered wood and alloy steel, with a rust-resistant frame, adjustable feet and a removable iron mesh magazine basket.

It ranks last because it offers little beyond the Vantimo and Yoobure, though the basket is a unique touch for books and magazines.

Best for a reading nook. The caveat is no charging or drawers.

methodology.title: Charging
methodology.description: Outlets and USB ports were counted where listed.

methodology.title: Capacity and stability
methodology.description: Stated weight ratings and adjustable feet were weighed.

methodology.title: Value within the field
methodology.description: Price tier was compared only against other narrow nightstands in this guide.

whatMatters.detail: Measure the space between the bed and the wall, then subtract an inch for clearance. A 7 inch table fits where a 12 inch table will not.
Tables near 7 inches wide hold less. Drawers and charging fit in only the more expensive ones. Decide whether you need hidden storage.
Stated capacities in this guide run from 30 lb to 210 lb. A lamp, clock and books can weigh more than you expect.
A 19.7 inch table is below most mattresses. Heights near 23 to 25 inches suit standard beds.
Narrow tables tip more easily. Adjustable feet and non-slip pads help.

cards.label: Open shelves
cards.text: Slimmest and cheapest, with everything in view. Picks: Vantimo, HOOBRO, Furinno, Yoobure, Homleke.

cards.label: Drawers
cards.text: Hide clutter and often add power, at a higher price. Picks: LOAKEKEL, LOAKEKEL Set of 2, Giantex.

howToChoose.note: Default to open shelves unless you need to hide cables and clutter.

howToChoose.subheading: By What You Need to Hold

cards.label: Look for
cards.text: Quick assembly, adjustable feet for uneven floors and a footprint that clears walkways.

cards.label: In this comparison
cards.text: The HOOBRO Industrial Narrow Nightstand builds in about five minutes, and the Vantimo has adjustable footpads.

cards.label: Spend more if
cards.text: You need power and closed storage. The LOAKEKEL Narrow Nightstand with USB-C packs both into 7.87 inches.

cards.label: Save if
cards.text: You just need a surface. The Vantimo 3-Tier Narrow Nightstand is the cheapest.

faq.q: How narrow can a nightstand be?
faq.a: In this guide, the Vantimo is 7.08 inches wide and the Homleke is 7.1 inches deep, with the LOAKEKEL at 7.87.
They can. Adjustable feet, as on the Vantimo and Yoobure, and non-slip pads on the Giantex help.

faq.q: Can I get a narrow nightstand with charging?
faq.a: Yes. The LOAKEKEL has two AC outlets, USB-A and USB-C, and is available as a single or a set of two.

faq.q: What is the strongest narrow nightstand?
faq.a: The Giantex is rated to 210 lb, though it is wider than the slimmest options.
It indicates responsibly sourced wood. The Furinno lists FSC and CARB compliance.
The HOOBRO lists tool-free assembly in about five minutes.

finalTake: For most narrow bedrooms, the LOAKEKEL Narrow Nightstand with USB-C is the right buy: 7.87 inches wide with charging and two drawers. For the tightest gap, the Vantimo is 7.08 inches. For heavy use, the Giantex is rated to 210 lb. For a pair, take the LOAKEKEL set of two.
